PR #372 Copilot review-fix cycle 1 — thread PRRT_kwDORzpWpM6amwKH (comment 3816508984) was raised on docs/memory/2026-08-19/circuit-break-stage-authority-audit-143-S.md line 35 and is recorded here for feature-level traceability. Attempt 3 of that breaker recorded the SUCCESSFUL authority audit as the third failed attempt, which corrupts the breaker's evidentiary value: a breaker's attempt log must count failures. It now records the actual third failure — the BLOCKED review at c1bfddc8 with its six P1 findings and evidence, in the same house format as attempts 1 and 2 — and the successful authority audit is moved into Context as corrective work performed before that attempt. attempts: 3 integrity preserved; attempts 1 and 2 untouched. PR #372 review-fix cycle 3 (P2-2). DoD role-boundary bullet completed to the full forbidden verb set declared by owner 134.002-T -- triage / prioritize / re-prioritize / re-classify / edit / harvest / deliberate on / discretionary removal AND discretionary archival -- with an explicit owner citation so the DoD references rather than duplicates the source of truth, and with Step 7 manifest-derived post-merge cleanup preserved as the stated exception. Judged acceptance-authoritative: Ship checks the DoD at completion, so the prior omission of re-prioritize and discretionary archival would have let a conforming implementation leave Ship free to archive a Stage-owned entry. Root-cause-guard bullet extended: no C2 carrier may make a PR, a review thread, OR a successful discovery lookup a precondition for capture.
